clue.text: Railway workers from the UK picketing East German port

indicators.note: pickets stand around a works gate, so the railwaymen surround the compass point

parts.note: BR is British Rail, the old UK railway, and its workers are MEN
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: Striking British railwaymen form a picket line at a port in East Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picketing' means surrounding, as pickets ring a gate. BR stands for British Rail, the former national railway. Bremen is in north-west Germany, so 'East German' misleads.
explanation.definitionFit: Bremen is a major port city on the Weser in northern Germany.

clue.text: Object to work, then do some in a studio

parts.note: OP is the usual short form of opus, a work
an artist's model will pose for some time in a studio

explanation.surface: Someone objects to a job and then models for a painter.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist or argue against something is to object to it.

clue.text: People who take steps to air their grievances in public

definitions.text: People who take steps to air their grievances in public

parts.words: People who take steps to air their grievances in public
parts.note: taking steps is read literally: people walking through the streets with banners to complain

explanation.definitionFit: Demonstrators who walk in procession to complain publicly are literally taking steps.

clue.text: Pricy sort of article from a Mediterranean island

indicators.note: to sort letters is to rearrange them, so the word pricy is shuffled

parts.note: AN is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: An expensive kind of item imported from a Mediterranean island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' looks like 'kind of' describing a pricy article, but it signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Cyprian is the adjective for Cyprus, the eastern Mediterranean island.

clue.text: They play an important role in the cash furnishing trade

definitions.text: They play an important role in the cash furnishing trade

parts.words: They play an important role in the cash furnishing trade
parts.note: read the trade as commerce and furnishing as supplying money: financiers who fund dealers

explanation.definitionFit: City financiers lend capital to businesses engaged in commerce, supplying funds for trade.

clue.text: Taken liberties and exceed one's station?

definitions.meaning: to take liberties is to overstep acceptable bounds
read literally: to travel beyond the stop you meant to get off at, or socially beyond your rank

explanation.definitionFit: Overstepping the mark is taking liberties, and riding past your stop is overshooting a station.

clue.text: Take part in a trial

parts.note: a trial here is a practice run, where actors go through their parts before the performance

explanation.definitionFit: Actors practise their roles in a trial run before the real show.

clue.text: A quality Gandhi prided himself on not having

definitions.meaning: a characteristic or attribute of something

definitions.text: Gandhi prided himself on not having
definitions.meaning: Gandhi lived in poverty and owned almost no possessions

explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a quality, and possessions are what the ascetic Gandhi renounced.

clue.text: Returns and does havoc, the wind and weather does in the long run

definitions.text: the wind and weather does in the long run

parts.note: split as re-turns: RE (about) turned round makes ER

indicators.note: doing havoc to the word does throws its letters into disorder

explanation.surface: Something comes back and wreaks havoc, as storms do over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Returns' is read as RE turned, giving ER; 'havoc' rearranges DOES into ODES.
explanation.definitionFit: Weathering slowly wears away rock and soil over long periods.

clue.text: Extremely good golfing place in Cornwall

definitions.meaning: the standard score for a hole, a good round for any golfer
A village and harbour near St Austell in Cornwall, the county at England's south-western tip

explanation.definitionFit: Matching the standard score on a hole is fine golf, and Par is a small Cornish port.

clue.text: He falsely pretends I'm after foreign gold

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
POST is Latin for after, as in postwar
OR is French for gold, and the heraldic term

explanation.surface: A conman claims he is chasing gold abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraud who passes himself off as someone else falsely pretends.

clue.text: Ends with a hundred, but doesn't win the game

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
to fail to win a game is to lose it

explanation.surface: A batsman reaches his century but his side still loses the match.
explanation.definitionFit: To finish or conclude something is to end it.

clue.text: What the Kaiser and Hitler pinned their sinking hopes on in their fight against the Allies

definitions.text: What the Kaiser and Hitler pinned their sinking hopes on in their fight against the Allies

parts.words: What the Kaiser and Hitler pinned their sinking hopes on in their fight against the Allies
parts.note: sinking hopes is literal: Germany relied on U-boats to sink Allied shipping in both world wars

explanation.definitionFit: U-boat campaigns against Allied convoys were Germany's main naval strategy in both world wars.

clue.text: Obscure Frenchman Id set up

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: M is the abbreviation of Monsieur, a Frenchman
taken as written

explanation.surface: A little-known Frenchman sets up the id of psychoanalysis.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dim is faint or unclear, hard to make out.

clue.text: If there's tribal war they are likely to get soundly beaten

definitions.text: If there's tribal war they are likely to get soundly beaten

parts.words: If there's tribal war they are likely to get soundly beaten
parts.note: soundly beaten means struck to make a noise, as war drums are, not defeated

explanation.definitionFit: Hand drums used by tribal peoples are beaten to signal war.

clue.text: Where the name of the pop-song was registered?

definitions.text: Where the name of the pop-song was registered?

parts.words: Where the name of the pop-song was registered?
parts.note: registered as officially noted, and a pop song is pressed on a disc

explanation.definitionFit: Officially noted facts are documented; a song's title also appears on its vinyl disc.

clue.text: A primate in a Chiltern township coming to the point

indicators.note: the primate is placed inside the name of the town

parts.note: Tring is a small town in the Chiltern Hills of Hertfordshire
an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: An ape loose in a Hertfordshire town gets to the heart of the matter.
explanation.walkthrough: TRING is a market town in the Chiltern Hills, north-west of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Something narrowing gradually to a tip is converging on a point.

clue.text: Group of editors of legendary fame

indicators.note: to group things is to arrange them, so the letters of editors are rearranged

explanation.surface: A team of newspaper editors with a famous reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrated in tales and history, a storied place is legendary.

clue.text: Fury that is inwardly right

indicators.note: inwardly means right sits inside the abbreviation

parts.note: IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Anger that is morally justified deep inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Ire is a literary word for anger or rage.

clue.text: A High-Churchman before and after his appointed hour

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
arriving past the set time is being late

explanation.surface: A bishop who turns up both early and late.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop or archbishop is a senior cleric of the Church.

clue.text: What we have a right to expect from a decent health service?

definitions.text: What we have a right to expect from a decent health service?

parts.words: What we have a right to expect from a decent health service?
parts.note: describes the fitting medical care patients deserve, with right picking up the sense of correct

explanation.definitionFit: Patients deserve correct and fitting medical care from their doctors.

clue.text: Garden chore due to many

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many
money due is owing

explanation.surface: A gardening job that falls to a crowd of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting the lawn is a regular gardening task.

clue.text: Accommodation for troops held back by sickness in winter

indicators.note: back means the held letters are read in reverse order
the answer is held within the run of letters of these words

explanation.surface: Soldiers' quarters are kept out of use by winter illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held' picks NESSIN from 'sickness in', and 'back' turns it round. A NISSEN hut is a curved corrugated-iron shelter used by the army.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nissen hut was a prefabricated corrugated-iron hut used as military barracks.

clue.text: Burn up the miles in a car?

definitions.text: Burn up the miles in a car?

parts.words: Burn up the miles in a car?
parts.note: to burn up the miles is to drive very fast, and burn is also the literal sense of singeing

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to singe and, informally, to drive at great speed.

clue.text: In a similar way an untruth about a London garden suburb is

indicators.note: about means the untruth goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a lie is an untruth
Kew, in south-west London, is home to the Royal Botanic Gardens
taken as written

explanation.surface: A false story told about a London suburb with famous gardens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' means the untruth wraps round the suburb and 'is'. Kew Gardens are the Royal Botanic Gardens in south-west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing the same thing in the same manner is acting similarly.

clue.text: Are set back a number of years

indicators.note: set back means the word are is written in reverse

explanation.surface: Things have been delayed by several years.
explanation.definitionFit: An age or epoch is a long period of time.

clue.text: The crowns of Denmark and Norway

definitions.text: The crowns of Denmark and Norway

parts.words: The crowns of Denmark and Norway
parts.note: crowns read as currency units rather than royal headgear

explanation.definitionFit: The Danish and Norwegian currency units are named after the crown.

clue.text: Full of humanity

parts.note: humanity read as people in large numbers rather than kindness

explanation.definitionFit: A place packed with a crowd of people is crammed full of people.
